meta.name: bankofai-guide
meta.description: Onboarding guide for BofAI skills — handles post-install setup, AgentWallet creation, and wallet guard when no wallet is configured.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 BofAI 技能安装后的钱包配置与保护
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 BofAI 技能，需要设置 AgentWallet 并启用保护。
copy.tagline_en: Set up AgentWallet and guard after installing BofAI skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed a BofAI skill and need to configure AgentWallet with protection.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在你安装新技能时引导创建AgentWallet钱包；在其他技能需要链上操作但未配置钱包时，先提示创建钱包。
howto.when: 安装新技能（如运行npx skills add后）、主动要求创建钱包，或进行转账、交易等需要钱包的操作时触发。

say.note: 引导创建或显示已有钱包地址
若无钱包，会先引导创建

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to create an AgentWallet when a new skill is added, and will prompt wallet creation before any on-chain operation if no wallet is configured.
howto.when_en: Triggered after installing a new skill (e.g., running 'npx skills add'), when you request wallet creation, or when signing skills need a wallet for transfers/trading.

say_en.note: Guides creation or displays existing wallet
Prompts wallet creation if none exists
